settings.heading: PRE-ORDER SPECIALS
settings.term_1: The pre-order discount will be automatically applied at checkout page during launch when you use the same email address registered for your pre-order reservation.
settings.term_2: Each pre-order reservation is eligible for one Hako Nomad and one Hako Nomad L purchase.
settings.term_3: Each variant must be purchased in a separate order to redeem the discount.
